name: set_call_intent
description: Call this as soon as you understand why the caller is calling. Do NOT wait — identify the intent and call this immediately, then continue helping in the same response.

name: end_call
description: Signal that the conversation is naturally complete and the caller is ready to hang up. Include a brief goodbye in your text response.

reason.description: Brief reason the call is ending

name: book_appointment
description: Book an appointment after the caller has confirmed the details (name, date/time, service type). Call this only after confirmation.

service_type.description: Type of service or consultation requested

notes.description: Any additional notes about the appointment or client needs

name: record_customer_request
description: Record a message or callback request after collecting the caller's name, callback number, and message (and preferred callback time for callbacks). Call this when the caller wants to leave a message or have someone call them back.

request_type.description: Whether this is a message to pass along or a request for a callback

message.description: The message or reason for callback

preferred_time.description: When they prefer to be called back (for callback type)

name: request_transfer
description: Transfer the caller to a human. Use when the caller asks for a person/representative/manager in any language, or when you cannot help and transfer is appropriate.

name: get_caller_appointments_from_db
description: Look up the caller's scheduled appointments in our database by their phone or name. Use when the business does not have an EHR integration.

name: cancel_appointment_db
description: Cancel an appointment in our database. Use appointment_id from get_caller_appointments_from_db, or omit if the caller has only one appointment (we use the one we looked up).

appointment_id.description: UUID of the appointment to cancel (optional if caller has one appointment)

client_name.description: The name the appointment is booked under, if the caller gave one. Only used together with phone_last4 to verify the appointment belongs to them when they're calling from a different number — a name on its own is never enough.

phone_last4.description: The last 4 digits of the phone number the appointment is booked under, as stated by the caller. REQUIRED whenever the caller is not calling from that number and you are identifying them by name — without it the cancellation will be refused.

name: reschedule_appointment_db
description: Reschedule an appointment in our database to a new date/time. Use appointment_id from get_caller_appointments_from_db, or omit if the caller has only one appointment.

appointment_id.description: UUID of the appointment (optional if caller has one appointment)

new_scheduled_at.description: New date and time in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2026-04-15T10:00:00)

client_name.description: The name the appointment is booked under, if the caller gave one. Only used together with phone_last4 to verify the appointment belongs to them when they're calling from a different number — a name on its own is never enough.

phone_last4.description: The last 4 digits of the phone number the appointment is booked under, as stated by the caller. REQUIRED whenever the caller is not calling from that number and you are identifying them by name — without it the reschedule will be refused.
